That's worth examining. Specifically kar mood tomar own mood ke sobcheye beshi affect kore?
amar partner, ora kharap mood e thakle ami o kharap feel kori

That kind of emotional fusion is common in close relationships but can become exhausting if there's no separation at all. Building small individual grounding practices - things that stabilize your mood independent of anyone else - can help create healthier emotional boundaries over time.
